WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT mt.MediaTypeId,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
         COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType mt
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall_average_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
), above_average AS (
  SELECT r.rate, r.track_count, o.overall_average_rate
  FROM media_type_rates r
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE r.rate > o.overall_average_rate
)
SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(track_count) AS average_number_of_tracks,
       AVG(rate - overall_average_rate) AS average_margin_above_overall_average
FROM above_average;
